description:
Creates, lists, shows and deletes thread files. Threads are the Projects, Processes and Topics that notes, logs, hours and payments hang from.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list threads (open only by default)
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CAT [--currency CUR] [--rate RATE] — create a thread file
  delete THREAD -y — permanently delete a thread file

Flags:
  list:
    QUERY   optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity
    --all   include paused and closed threads
    --json  JSON output
  show:
    --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME     required. Becomes the filename. Must not contain '/' or start with '.'.
    --kind          required. One of: project, process, topic. These map to the Projects/, Processes/ and Topics/ directories.
    --category      required. One of: professional, personal, voluntary
    --currency CUR  3-letter ISO code. Default currency for `hours`; setting it makes the thread billable.
    --rate N        default hourly rate for `hours`. Needs --currency.
  delete:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm the delete

Args:
  THREAD  thread name or 'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/SGB

Examples:
  ["list", "sgb"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "1500"]

Notes:
  People are not threads. Create people with `people new`.
  delete is permanent. Without -y it refuses and exits 1.
  Exit code 1 also means: the thread already exists, the name is empty or invalid, or --rate was given without --currency.
